title: Say Hello
story: Chilaka the parrot only repeats what you teach it. Today's lesson: the very first word.
goal: Make the program print exactly: Hello, Aata!
hints: Python shows text on the screen with a function called print(). What goes inside the brackets?
Text goes inside quotes. The shape is print("...").
socratic: Which function shows something on the screen?
How does Python know something is plain text and not a command?
Compare your output with the goal letter by letter. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what do the quotation marks do?
